decisive_items: Nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate (H&E stain)
T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
Admixed atypical, irregularly contoured lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
response.rationale: The presence of atypical lymphocytes, nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, and clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements support the diagnosis of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, which is a broader category that includes mycosis fungoides.

rejected.why: Sézary syndrome is a specific type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, but the provided information does not specifically support this diagnosis over other types of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
